text: **dsh-wechat-plugin**（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把微信接入 DSH，会话消息经 Tencent iLink 收发，并在 DSH 设置页扫码绑定账号。它可将微信文字和媒体送入 DSH 会话、从手机切换会话或模型、回复权限确认和结构化问题，并把文本、图片、视频和文件发回微信；还提供跨会话主动通知及命令行发送。适合希望用手机继续操作电脑上 DSH 的用户。需要可用的 DSH Web 组合和微信账号扫码绑定，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-wechat-plugin connects a DSH web client to WeChat through Tencent iLink. Bind by QR code, send messages and media to DSH sessions, manage conversations and models, answer prompts, and send files or notifications back. It requires DSH and a WeChat account; no API key is required.
想直接用手机微信给电脑上的 DSH agent 发任务并收到回复。
有没有办法在微信里继续使用我电脑上已经开始的 DSH 对话？
我想把微信收到的照片、语音或文档交给 DSH 会话处理。
能不能在手机上回复 DSH 发来的权限确认和选项问题？
我想从微信查看电脑上的会话列表，然后切到另一个会话。
让 DSH 的其他会话也能把完成通知或文件发到我的微信。
我想在手机聊天里切换当前 DSH 会话使用的模型或推理等级。
I want to message the DSH agent on my computer from WeChat and get its replies on my phone.
Can I answer DSH approval prompts and multiple-choice questions through WeChat?
I need a way to send a file from a DSH script to the WeChat conversation that is currently bound.
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「扫码绑定」：在 DSH 设置页启动登录任务并展示二维码；用户扫码、确认或填写配对码后，账号被保存并可自动重连。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「微信消息接入会话」：微信文字和语音转写被转换为入站消息；每个微信对话映射到 DSH 会话，消息作为提示提交并把助手回复发回微信。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「会话管理」：在微信发送 /new、/list、/switch、/current 或 /cancel，可新建、浏览、切换会话、查看当前会话或中断任务；回复列表编号也能选择。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「模型控制」：用微信 /model 查看可用模型和推理等级，并为当前绑定的 DSH 会话切换模型或调整等级。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「手机回答交互请求」：DSH 的权限请求和结构化问题会发到绑定的微信对话；用户回复允许/拒绝或选项编号后，结果返回给 DSH。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「双向媒体传输」：收到的图片、语音、视频或文件会下载并保存到会话工作区供 agent 读取；agent 也可把本机文件作为图片、视频或附件发送到微信。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「主动通知」：DSH 工具 notify_wechat 可从其他会话向当前绑定的微信会话发送文字并附加文件；文本片段还能合并发送。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「设置与诊断页面」：DSH Web 设置中的微信页面可绑定账号、启停通道、修改行为设置，并查看状态和启动日志。
**dsh-wechat-plugin** 的功能「命令行发送」：脚本可调用 dsh-wechat-send 向已绑定的微信会话发文字或附带文件，命令与插件共用发送计数和排队状态。

work.

No OpenClaw, and no public IP required.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · dsh-wechat-plugin：**Runs on the current DSH desktop app** — developed and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, and kept
current as the desktop app moves on. A lot of community plugins quietly stopped working when DSH
updated; this one is maintained alongside it, and every change is released through CI.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Features：- **Text both ways.** Your WeChat message becomes a DSH prompt; the reply comes back to WeChat.
- **Photos, files, voice, video** — both directions. Attachments are saved into the session workspace
  and handed to the agent; the agent can send files back with `send_to_wechat`.
- **One WeChat chat, many DSH sessions.** `/new`, `/list`, `/switch`, `/model`, `/current`, `/cancel` — or just
  say "switch to the other one".
- **Answer permission prompts from your phone.** Approvals and multiple-choice questions are sent to
  WeChat and answered with a number, so being away from the desk does not stall the agent.
- **Settings page** under **Settings → WeChat**.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Install：**For the DSH desktop app.** It needs DSH's workspace, tool and UI services — the standard desktop
composition — on a machine that stays on. Tested against `0.2.1-rc.3`, and updated alongside the
desktop app.

Open the **plugin** entry in the sidebar and choose **添加插件** (add plugin). The field takes a package
name, a Git URL, a tarball, or a local path.

From npm — nothing to configure ``` dsh-wechat-plugin ``` Add a version if you need one: `dsh-wechat-plugin@0.36.5`.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Install：
From GitHub — builds itself, for tracking a branch or a commit ``` https://github.com/xcisxc29/dsh-wechat ``` DSH clones the repository and builds it. **pnpm will stop the build once and ask you to allow it** — that is expected, and it is how any Git-hosted plugin builds. dsh-wechat-workspace README · Getting started：After restarting DSH, open **Settings → WeChat**, click **重新扫码** (rescan), and scan the QR code with
your phone. Send `你好` from WeChat and you should get a reply.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Optional: voice to text：WeChat voice notes are SILK. Install this codec to transcribe them to WAV locally:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add silk-wasm
```

Without it voice still works: the raw SILK file is saved and handed to the agent along with the
service's own transcription.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Usage：Just send a message and it reaches the agent:

```
你好
```

Type these to control which DSH conversation you are talking to:

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Usage：| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/new` | Start a fresh conversation. Anything after it becomes the title: `/new 修复登录` starts a conversation called 「修复登录」. Without one, the conversation gets a name from your first message |
| `/list` | This workspace's conversations — it opens that level directly (up to 10 rows per screen) |
| `/list all` | The **workspaces** on this machine, one row each with its conversation count. Reply with a number or a name to enter one |
| `/switch 3` | Move to number 3 on that screen |
| `/switch e716f0` | Move by the **short id printed at the end of the row** — independent of numbering, so it never goes stale |
| `查看其余` | The next ten rows, at either level, all the way to the end. Numbers run on across screens (1–10, then 11–20) |
| reply `3`, a name, or a row's short id | Works with the listing on screen — no `/switch` needed |
| quote the list, then `/switch 3` | Move to number 3 **of that screen**, frozen in the message you quoted |
| `/model` | List the models and each one's **reasoning levels**, marking the model and level in use |
| `/model 2` | Switch to number 2, or send a model name instead |
| `/model 等级

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Usage：**Spaces are optional**: `/switch3`, `/switch 3` and `/switch:3` all work.

**Numbers go stale.** Conversations run while you read the list, so by the time you reply "3" the third
row may be a different one. That is why every row ends with a short id of **at most six characters** —
which a reply or `/switch` takes directly — and why quoting a listing and replying with a number
resolves against the numbers *that screen* printed.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Usage：**The list is two levels, ten rows at a time.** `/list` opens this workspace's conversations; `/list
all` opens the workspaces on the machine, and you enter one by number or by name. Either level pages
with `查看其余`, numbering runs on across screens (1–10, then 11–20), and the last screen says so
instead of offering a step that does nothing. Entering a workspace only moves where you are browsing —
it does not move your conversation, which still takes a second reply inside it.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Usage：**Plain language works too** — "switch to the other one", "what conversations do I have", "stop". The
agent judges the intent rather than matching fixed rules, and a switch tells you whether it succeeded
or failed.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Security：**Only you can reach it.** The channel talks to Tencent's official iLink gateway, and nothing else —
no third-party service, no self-hosted relay in the middle. When you scan the QR code, the bot is
**cryptographically bound to your WeChat account**: the token it receives embeds your `ilink_user_id`,
and the service only ever delivers messages from that one account. The bot is not a WeChat contact —
it has no shareable card, nothing searches for it, and nobody can add it. There is no "someone else
could message it" surface, which is why no allowlist exists: the protocol already is one.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Security：Two things are still true and worth knowing:

**Conversations from WeChat run with full permissions by default** — the agent does not ask before it
acts. That is deliberate: a permission prompt is delivered to WeChat and the task then waits there, so
on a phone every command would stall until you answered a conversation you had walked away from. Set
**Permissions for WeChat conversations** to `Follow the DSH setting` in the settings page if you want
the same guardrails you have at the desk.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Security：**The agent runs as you.** It can execute commands and read and write files, with your user's
permissions — that is what it is for, and it means anything you can do on this machine, it can do.
So: skim what you asked for before walking away, and **lock the screen** when you leave. Locking does
not stop the agent (see the user guide), and it keeps anyone passing by out of your desktop.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Security：**Any session on this machine can push to your WeChat by default.** That is what makes "tell me when it
is done" work: the session doing the work is usually not the one your WeChat conversation is bound to,
and without this it could not report its own result. Turn off **Let other sessions push to WeChat** to
restore the stricter rule, where only the bound session may send.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build              # compiles only, leaving @dsh-wechat/core imports for pack to rewrite
pnpm run dist           # build + inline core: the loadable form a Git install needs
pnpm typecheck

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Development：Two build outputs, on purpose. `build` is the compiling step alone, and it keeps
`@dsh-wechat/core` as a package import so `pack` can redirect it into the vendored `dist/core`.
`dist` runs that compile and then rewrites the import to a relative path instead, which is what a Git
install ends up with — it clones the repository and runs `prepare`, never `pack`.

dsh-wechat-workspace README · Development：**Rebuild `core` after changing it.** Tests resolve `@dsh-wechat/core` through `node_modules` to
`lib/`, so source edits without a rebuild test the *old* code — and pass.
